notes: Canonical = terminal (latest-ending) label of the continuity chain; standalone labels are their own canonical.
Only relay/alias edges collapse a label into its canonical target; split-from/absorbed-into edges never move the canonical id.
'niez.' (non-attached) is always its own canonical label and carries no edges — its membership is churn by definition.
backtest_layers.CLUB_MAP (pre-table, term-10-only) chose Polska2050-TD as the alias representative; this table uses the terminal label Polska2050 — the alias edge preserves the equivalence.
PSL-PBL (term 4) and PSL-UED (term 8) are coalition labels: kept whole (never decomposed), components recorded from the overlap evidence.

jaccard/containment are set-similarity measures over full-term MP membership; they are evidence for continuity, not a definition of organizational history. Direction of a relay edge A→B means 'B's sittings continue A's' and is checked against per-label sitting runs (a label's span may be non-contiguous — e.g. PLD term 4 pauses while FKP carries the same members), so first/last dates alone cannot decide direction.

Renaming cycles (A→B→A where the same continuity changes label and changes back) are possible; the canonical id still resolves to the terminal label of the chain (e.g. PLD→FKP→PLD→SG in term 4, all resolving to SG).
scope: terms 3-10 (frozen evaluation corpus); registry of every raw API club label
